scoreBasis.accessibility: Named controls, composite ARIA and radio keyboard handlers are present. The cart scroll container lacks the documented named keyboard region; rendered contrast/focus/zoom were not assessed.
scoreBasis.performance: Search results capped at eight and memoized; bounded popup measurement with equality guard. No verified major performance defect; no runtime profiling performed.
scoreBasis.responsive: Container-based layout and internal tablet scrolling exist. The sole cart product identity still ellipsizes without a reveal path. Four-unit and large-amount states remain rendered verification questions.
scoreBasis.theming: POS surfaces, text, borders and states use runtime token families; no verified dark-mode failure in source. This is implementation scoring, not a rendered contrast certificate.
scoreBasis.integrity: Approved component families and explicit preview semantics remain coherent. Several POS strings and amount words bypass the active language preference.

falsePositives.reason: Reject all three hits. Geist/Hind Siliguri are explicitly approved by taste T1 and the design guide. A managed Geist Mono import does not demonstrate monospaced money in POS; cart/input overrides reset numeric font features.

problems.evidence: Source verified: sole cart product name is a plain truncate paragraph, with no title, expand/details action or full-name reveal. src/index.css:324 forces nowrap/ellipsis on identity paragraphs below 760px cart width; :337 restricts identity to phone grid columns 3–7. Applies in both themes; T2/T5/T6 and design guide §18 prohibit unrevealable sole identity. Exact clipping for a particular product was not rendered in this isolated audit.
problems.fix: Within the existing compact phone cart, make the full product name available through natural wrapping or an accessible reveal, preserving total/remove and tablet one-row behavior. Confirm with long real English/Bangla identities.

problems.evidence: Source verified: AmountInWordsDisplay is called without language or label, so its default language=Bangla and label=In words · কথায় remain in Full English. Pos.tsx:764 and :899 render unconditional Bangla helpers; :899–902 hard-code Quick items and Tap to add. ProductCombobox.tsx:279–294 unconditionally renders Bangla product helper and English stock/service copy. CSS :308–310 supplies English Qty/Unit/Price regardless of preference. T9 and the brief require English/Bangla preference parity.
problems.fix: Pass explicit active language and localized label to the existing AmountInWordsDisplay only from POS; route POS-owned labels through existing copy helpers and gate secondary Bangla helpers with showHelper. Preserve entered product names and shared consumer defaults.

problems.evidence: Source verified: cart overflow-x-auto wrapper is an unlabelled div without region semantics or tabIndex. src/index.css:898 intentionally creates a 760/844/920px minimum row width at tablet sizes. Design guide §18 requires comparative horizontal scrolling inside a labelled keyboard-reachable region; T7 requires keyboard scroll access. Descendant fields can still receive focus, so this is not asserted as a proven keyboard task blocker.
problems.fix: Give the existing cart scroll surface a localized accessible region name and keyboard focus when overflow exists, preserving descendant Tab order and normal internal scroll. Verify keyboard scrolling/focus and touch in the real tablet cart.

sourceImprovementsObserved.evidence: ProductCombobox.tsx:136–147 scrolls only its list to the active option; :162/:197 guard composition and keyCode 229. CartTable.tsx:369 opts into posKeyboardSafety; default stays false for existing consumers.
CartTable.tsx:287–296 implements roving Tab focus plus arrows/Home/End. CheckoutPanel.tsx:219–233 applies equivalent keyboard selection to discount mode.
index.css:784–809 imposes 13/12/11 roles and proportional digits with high-specificity inherited overrides. No remaining computed-scale defect is established from source alone.
index.css:898–899 budgets 760px routine rows and :929 preserves total as a real grid cell. Actual fit remains the independent rendered reviewer’s responsibility.

openQuestions.question: Render a real four-unit line at 320/390/768/1024/1440, focused and unfocused, including four-character symbols and multi-digit quantities. Equal flex slices, shrink-0 symbols, compact stepper reservation and overflow-hidden shell remain a source risk, not a verified clipping problem. No speculative change requested.

Render supported large BDT totals in payable, paid/due rows and the 48px terminal CTA at 320/390 and desktop checkout widths in all three language preferences. Large fixed type plus label+amount+F9 may exceed available inline space; source alone does not verify overflow. Reproduce before changing.
This isolated source audit ran the official detector only; full project lint/regression outcome belongs to the coordinator’s gate evidence. No conclusion inferred from the baseline ID.

implementationIntegrityVerdict: Pass with bounded gaps: product-specific shared controls and financial preview boundaries are retained; no verified detector cluster remains after owner-approved font exclusions.
summary: Official detector completed with three approved-font false positives and no retained detector cluster. Source audit scores 15/20 with three verified P2 gaps; four-unit and large-amount rendering require reproduction before any corrective edit.
limitations: Source-only independent assessment; no screenshots, browser, pixel contrast, gesture synthesis, runtime performance or test-gate results were inspected.
